Subject: SIG and DPA / HIPAA question for Redwood

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the demo last week — Acme Health is actively evaluating vendors for our patient-facing documentation assistant. Security is a hard requirement for us. Two quick asks to help our InfoSec + Procurement teams proceed:  

1) We're starting the SIG (Standardized Information Gathering) intake — can your team complete the SIG spreadsheet and return evidence for high-risk controls (encryption keys, SOC 2 artifacts, incident response runbooks)?

2) We need to understand Redwood's position on DPA + SCCs and whether a BAA is available or feasible for HIPAA workloads. If a BAA is possible, what deployment modes and contractual controls are required?

Can you confirm who will own the SIG completion and an expected turnaround? We're working to a procurement deadline of Nov 18.

Attachments: SIG_request_2026.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
Emily Ross
Security Program Manager
Acme Health

Date: 2026-11-05T15:03:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG and DPA / HIPAA question for Redwood

Emily — thanks for the note and the clear asks. I'm looping in Marissa (security/compliance lead) and Evelyn (legal ops) to drive SIG completion and the DPA/BAA discussion.

Short answers up front:
- We will start filling the SIG and can return a first-pass with supporting artifacts within 5 business days.
- We have a current SOC 2 Type II report — attaching for your review.
- Regarding HIPAA/BAA: we support HIPAA workloads on Dedicated or Private deployments; Hosted (multi-tenant) is possible with strict controls but requires additional contractual and architecture gating — Marissa will outline.
- SCCs / DPA: we can sign the EU DPA with SCCs; Evelyn will handle redlines.

I've attached the SOC 2 doc and assigned action items: Marissa to complete SIG sections A/B/C, Evelyn to review DPA redline and advise on SCCs/BAA language.

Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_Report_2026.pdf (stub)

Best,
Vivek

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-06T09:28:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG and DPA / HIPAA question for Redwood — partial responses and next steps

Hi Emily,

Thanks — I picked up the SIG and started completing it. Quick summary of what we've provided and open items:  

What we've returned (attached):
- SIG_partial_responses.xlsx — completed sections for Organization, Access Control, Data Protection, and Incident Response with references to evidence.
- Redwood_SOC2_Report_2026.pdf — attestation of control operation for the covered period.

Open / flagged items:
1) Data residency & SCCs: We can operate from EU regions and sign the standard SCCs. For certain customers we include the SCC addendum in the DPA; Evelyn will send a redline with the SCC references.

2) Encryption key management: Hosted customers use Redwood-managed keys (KMIP-compatible KMS). For Dedicated/Private we support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault). Evidence: see HIPAA_readiness_note.pdf (section 2.1) and the attached SOC2 report for encryption control descriptions.

3) Logging & retention: By default we retain request logs for 30 days with options for extended retention on Dedicated and Private. We can provide sample audit logs and access logs on request (redacts PII).

4) HIPAA / BAA feasibility:  
- We will sign a BAA for Dedicated and Private deployments where customers control network boundaries and (optionally) key management.
- For Hosted API (multi-tenant), we can discuss a limited BAA scope only if specific architectural constraints are met (VPC peering + dedicated tenancy + restricted token handling). That path requires a 2–3 week ops & legal review.

Proposed next steps and timeline:
- Today (Nov 6): send SIG_partial_responses.xlsx (attached) and DPA_redline_v1.docx (Evelyn).
- By Nov 11: complete remaining SIG control detail (we estimate 3 business days) and provide sample logs and encryption architecture diagrams.
- Legal review of DPA/BAA redline — Evelyn to follow up separately; target external comment by Nov 12.

Can we schedule a 30-minute call on Nov 9 or Nov 10 to run through the flagged items (SCCs, KMS options, and BAA gating)? My availability: Nov 9 09:00-11:00 UTC or Nov 10 13:00-16:00 UTC.

Attachments: SIG_partial_responses.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), DPA_redline_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document), HIPAA_readiness_note.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

Marissa / team — this is great progress, thank you. A few quick clarifications before the call:  

- For encryption keys: Can you provide the KMS configuration guide (how customer-managed keys are wired into inference runtime) and a sample key rotation policy?
- For logs: we'd like a sample 7-day and 90-day audit export to understand schema and redaction behavior.
- For the BAA: can you confirm whether Redwood would require Dedicated OR Private for signing, or if a hybrid Hosted + dedicated tenancy approach would ever be acceptable? We're trying to size the infra and procurement ask.

We can take Nov 10 at 14:00 UTC for a 30-minute session. Please send a calendar invite with a brief agenda (SCCs, KMS + encryption, BAA gating).

Also, procurement asked for a copy of the vendor risk assessment link — if you have a HubSpot or vendor portal record, please share.

Thanks,
Emily

Acme Health
